limits: Known author Timing and fixed detected attacks/counts in Sakura; this does not test automatic timing or transcription.
The same-song calibration support contains only 19 onset groups; repeated phrases can correlate across sections.
Source attribution inside simultaneous groups is still ambiguous.
Community inputs are authored attacks and counts with tails/columns removed; no paired audio entered this community fit.
The twenty comparison excerpts are development comparisons already inspected in earlier experiments.
Optimum objective value and legal occupancy do not certify musical quality.

aborted_preparation.reason: Corpus chart 2571106 contains a 1e-61 ms red-line period. Its cumulative beat clock reaches approximately 1e59, destroying later finite-duration resolution. The running preparation emitted log2(0), so its examples are not eligible for fitting. Preparation was stopped before changing feature implementation.
aborted_preparation.next: Validate clock invertibility and monotonicity, preserve explicit exclusions, rebuild in a new dataset directory.
